title: Project Slice & Data Model
description: Create the Project data model types and Zustand ProjectSlice. Define Project, Volume, Chapter interfaces with all required fields. Add ProjectSlice to appStore composition.
action: Create desktop/src/types/project.ts with Project, Volume, Chapter interfaces. Create desktop/src/stores/app/projectSlice.ts with ProjectSlice (CRUD for projects/volumes/chapters, currentChapterId, currentProjectId). Modify desktop/src/stores/appStore.ts to compose ProjectSlice.

convergence.verification: TypeScript compiles without errors, store accesses useAppStore(state => state.projects) returns initial empty state
convergence.definition_of_done: ProjectSlice is composed in appStore, all interfaces exported, CRUD actions (createProject, createVolume, createChapter, deleteChapter) are functional

files.target: Project, Volume, Chapter, ChapterContent type definitions
files.change: New file with TypeScript interfaces for the 3-level hierarchy
New Zustand slice with projects[], volumes[], chapters[], currentProjectId, currentChapterId, and CRUD actions
Add ProjectSlice to intersection type and spread into store creation

implementation: 1. Create desktop/src/types/project.ts: define Project { id, title, createdAt, updatedAt, volumes: string[] }, Volume { id, projectId, title, position, chapters: string[] }, Chapter { id, volumeId, projectId, title, position, wordCount, createdAt, updatedAt }, ChapterContent { content: JSONContent, version: number }

2. Create desktop/src/stores/app/projectSlice.ts: interface ProjectSlice with state (projects, volumes, chapters, currentProjectId, currentChapterId) and actions (createProject, deleteProject, createVolume, deleteVolume, createChapter, deleteChapter, updateChapter, setCurrentProject, setCurrentChapter)
3. Use nanoid for ID generation (import { nanoid } from 'nanoid')
4. Add ProjectSlice to appStore.ts: import projectSlice, add to AppState intersection type, spread createProjectSlice(...args) into store
test: Unit tests for ProjectSlice: create/delete project, create/delete volume, create/delete chapter, setCurrentProject/Chapter, updateChapter content
reference: ConversationSlice pattern from conversationSlice.ts, simple slice pattern from uiSlice.ts
rationale: Data model and store are the foundation — all other tasks depend on these types and the ProjectSlice for state management
risks: Store shape change may affect existing components — mitigated by L-006 adapter pattern in TASK-005
